# Tool catalog

<!-- Generated by `npm run docs:tools` from the server's registered tools. Do not edit by hand. -->

parsi-mcp exposes **56 tools**. All run offline.

| Tool | What it does | Parameters |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `gregorian_to_jalali` | Convert a Gregorian date to the Jalali (Persian) calendar. | `year`: integer<br>`month`: integer<br>`day`: integer |
| `jalali_to_gregorian` | Convert a Jalali (Persian) date to the Gregorian calendar. | `year`: integer<br>`month`: integer<br>`day`: integer |
| `jalali_year_info` | Leap-year status and month length for a Jalali year. | `year`: integer<br>`month?`: integer |
| `validate_national_id` | Validate an Iranian national ID (code melli) using its checksum. | `value`: string |
| `validate_card_number` | Validate a 16-digit Iranian bank card number (Luhn). | `value`: string |
| `validate_sheba` | Validate an Iranian Sheba (IBAN) number. | `value`: string |
| `normalize_mobile` | Validate and normalize an Iranian mobile number to 09xxxxxxxxx. | `value`: string |
| `normalize_persian_text` | Normalize Arabic letter variants to Persian, clean spacing, and convert digits to Persian. | `text`: string |
| `to_persian_digits` | Convert any digits in a string to Persian digits. | `text`: string |
| `number_to_persian_words` | Write a non-negative integer in Persian words, e.g. for invoices. | `value`: integer |
| `convert_rial_toman` | Convert between rial and toman (1 toman = 10 rial). | `amount`: number<br>`from`: "rial" \| "toman"<br>`to`: "rial" \| "toman" |
| `bank_from_card` | Identify the Iranian bank from a card number (first 6 digits / BIN). | `card`: string |
| `bank_from_sheba` | Identify the Iranian bank from a Sheba (IBAN) number (3-digit bank code). | `sheba`: string |
| `mobile_operator` | Detect the mobile operator (MCI/Irancell/Rightel) of an Iranian mobile number. | `value`: string |
| `landline_province` | Find the province of an Iranian landline number from its area code. | `value`: string |
| `validate_postal_code` | Validate an Iranian 10-digit postal code. | `value`: string |
| `persian_words_to_number` | Convert Persian number words to a number, e.g. 'دویست و پنجاه هزار' -> 250000. | `text`: string |
| `format_jalali_date` | Format a Jalali date. Tokens: YYYY YY MMMM MM M DD D dddd. | `year`: integer<br>`month`: integer<br>`day`: integer<br>`pattern?`: string<br>`persianDigits?`: boolean |
| `parse_jalali_date` | Parse text like '1403/05/09', '۱۴۰۳-۵-۹' or '9 مرداد 1403' into a Jalali date. | `text`: string |
| `jalali_add` | Add days, months and/or years to a Jalali date (month overflow clamps to month length). | `year`: integer<br>`month`: integer<br>`day`: integer<br>`days?`: integer<br>`months?`: integer<br>`years?`: integer |
| `jalali_diff` | Days between two Jalali dates plus a Persian relative description. | `from`: object<br>`to`: object |
| `slugify_persian` | Create a URL slug from Persian/Latin text. | `text`: string<br>`separator?`: string |
| `sanitize_persian_text` | Fix ZWNJ (half-space) for می/نمی and plural suffixes, Persian punctuation and spacing, Arabic letter variants. | `text`: string |
| `calculate_vat` | VAT helper. Rate (percent) must be supplied. mode 'exclusive' = amount excludes tax, 'inclusive' = amount includes tax. | `amount`: number<br>`ratePercent`: number<br>`mode`: "exclusive" \| "inclusive" |
| `format_number_grouped` | Group digits in threes (200000 -> 200,000 or ۲۰۰٬۰۰۰). Accepts Persian/Arabic digits. | `value`: string<br>`digits?`: "ascii" \| "persian"<br>`separator?`: "," \| "٬" |
| `parse_grouped_number` | Strip separators and Persian/Arabic digits to a clean number, e.g. '۲۰۰٬۰۰۰' -> '200000'. | `text`: string |
| `price_to_persian_words` | Amount in Persian words with unit, e.g. 200000 toman -> 'دویست هزار تومان'. Toman may have one decimal digit (tenths = rials). | `amount`: string<br>`unit?`: "toman" \| "rial" |
| `price_input_snippet` | Ready-to-use RTL-friendly price input code: digit grouping while typing with caret preserved, live Persian words (aria-live), raw value submission. variant 'core' returns the shared helpers. | `variant`: "react" \| "vue" \| "vanilla" \| "core" |
| `rtl_guidelines` | Full RTL frontend guidelines for Persian/Arabic UIs (also available as prompt and resource 'rtl-frontend-guidelines'). | none |
| `rtl_audit_css` | Scan CSS/HTML/JSX/Tailwind text for LTR-only patterns (margin-left, ml-4, text-align:left, float:left, left/right, forced ltr, directional icons...) and suggest logical replacements. | `code`: string |
| `rtl_convert_css` | Convert physical CSS (and React style objects) to logical properties. | `css`: string |
| `rtl_convert_tailwind` | Convert Tailwind physical utilities to logical ones (ml-4 -> ms-4, pr-2 -> pe-2, text-left -> text-start). | `text`: string |
| `rtl_starter_snippet` | Minimal RTL-ready setup for html, css, tailwind, nextjs, react or vue. | `framework`: "html" \| "css" \| "tailwind" \| "nextjs" \| "react" \| "vue" |
| `persian_relative_time` | Persian relative time like '۳ روز پیش' or '۲ ساعت دیگر'. Pass an ISO timestamp; 'now' defaults to the current time. Months = 30 days, years = 365 days. | `timestamp`: string<br>`now?`: string<br>`persianDigits?`: boolean |
| `jalali_month_grid` | Calendar grid for a Jalali month (for date-pickers): weeks of 7 cells with day number, Gregorian date and Friday flag; null cells pad the edges. Default week starts Saturday. | `year`: integer<br>`month`: integer<br>`weekStart?`: "saturday" \| "sunday" \| "monday" |
| `jalali_period_range` | Start/end (Jalali and Gregorian) of the Jalali day, week (Saturday-Friday), month, quarter (season) or year containing a date. Use for reports and finance periods instead of Gregorian date libraries. | `date`: object<br>`period`: "day" \| "week" \| "month" \| "quarter" \| "year" |
| `persian_ordinal` | Persian ordinal words: 3 -> سوم, 21 -> بیست و یکم, 30 -> سی‌ام. 1 gives اول (set firstAsYekom for یکم). | `value`: integer<br>`firstAsYekom?`: boolean |
| `persian_fuzzy_search` | Fuzzy-match a query against candidate strings, treating Arabic/Persian letter variants (ي/ی, ك/ک, آ/ا), diacritics, ZWNJ and digit styles as equal. Returns ranked matches with scores. | `query`: string<br>`candidates`: array<br>`threshold?`: number<br>`limit?`: integer |
| `persian_sort` | Sort strings in Persian alphabetical order (ا ب پ ت ... ی). Digits first (numeric), then Persian, then Latin. Ignores ZWNJ and Arabic/Persian letter variants. | `items`: array<br>`order?`: "asc" \| "desc" |
| `fix_keyboard_layout` | Fix text typed with the wrong keyboard layout using the standard Iranian layout (ISIRI 9147): 'sghl' -> 'سلام', and Persian typed on English back to Latin. direction 'auto' picks by script. | `text`: string<br>`direction?`: "auto" \| "en-to-fa" \| "fa-to-en" |
| `validate_legal_national_id` | Validate an 11-digit Iranian legal-entity national ID (شناسه ملی شخص حقوقی / company ID) with its checksum. | `value`: string |
| `csv_export_safe` | Build Excel/Sheets-safe CSV from rows: UTF-8 BOM, correct quoting, Persian digits in numeric cells converted to ASCII so Excel treats them as numbers, formula-injection guard, warnings for digit strings Excel may corrupt. | `rows`: array<br>`delimiter?`: "," \| ";" \| "tab"<br>`bom?`: boolean<br>`excelSafe?`: boolean |
| `persian_font_preset` | CSS for Persian fonts (vazirmatn, shabnam, sahel, iransans): import link, font stack with fallbacks, RTL base styles. IRANSans is commercial so no CDN is given. | `font`: "vazirmatn" \| "shabnam" \| "sahel" \| "iransans"<br>`selector?`: string |
| `iran_provinces` | List Iran's 31 provinces with ISO 3166-2 code, Persian/English names and capital. Optional query matches Persian or English names (letter-variant tolerant). | `query?`: string |
| `persian_text_stats` | Character, letter, digit, ZWNJ, word, sentence and paragraph counts for Persian/mixed text, plus reading time. wordsPerMinute is an adjustable assumption (default 180). | `text`: string<br>`wordsPerMinute?`: number |
| `detect_text_direction` | Detect text direction (first-strong and dominant script, mixed flag) and optionally wrap the text bidi-safely: Unicode isolates (FSI/RLI/LRI) or HTML <bdi> / dir=auto. Use for usernames, product names and mixed Persian/English strings. | `text`: string<br>`wrap?`: "isolate" \| "rli" \| "lri" \| "html-bdi" \| "html-dir-auto" |
| `truncate_persian_text` | Truncate text to maxLength (ellipsis included) without breaking words, ZWNJ-joined words, surrogate pairs or diacritics. mode 'word' (default) or 'char'. | `text`: string<br>`maxLength`: integer<br>`ellipsis?`: string<br>`mode?`: "word" \| "char" |
| `persian_lorem_ipsum` | Deterministic Persian placeholder text (seeded, original word list; not real prose) for mockups. | `paragraphs?`: integer<br>`sentencesPerParagraph?`: integer<br>`wordsPerSentence?`: integer<br>`seed?`: integer |
| `format_iran_phone` | Display formats for an Iranian mobile (0912 345 6789, +98 912 345 6789, E.164) or landline (021-12345678). Accepts Persian digits, +98, 0098. | `value`: string<br>`persianDigits?`: boolean |
| `format_short_number` | Short Persian number form: 2500000 -> '۲٫۵ میلیون', 1200 -> '۱٫۲ هزار' (style 'latin' gives 2.5M). Optional unit like تومان. | `value`: number<br>`style?`: "persian" \| "latin"<br>`persianDigits?`: boolean<br>`maxFraction?`: integer<br>`unit?`: string |
| `decimal_to_persian_words` | Decimals, percents and fractions in Persian words: '12.5' -> 'دوازده ممیز پنج دهم', percent adds درصد, fraction '3/4' -> 'سه چهارم'. | `value`: string<br>`mode?`: "decimal" \| "percent" \| "fraction"<br>`halfAsNim?`: boolean |
| `jalali_age` | Age (years, months, days, total days) from a Jalali birth date. asOf defaults to today. | `birth`: object<br>`asOf?`: object |
| `validate_jalali_date` | Form validation for a Jalali date with readable reasons: month/day ranges (leap-aware), min, max and notFuture checks. Never throws. | `date`: object<br>`min?`: object<br>`max?`: object<br>`notFuture?`: boolean |
| `iran_business_days` | Business-day helper: op 'is_business_day', 'add' (days may be negative) or 'count' (days after 'date' up to and including 'to'). Weekend is Friday (optionally Thursday too); supply holidays yourself or enable the fixed solar ones. | `op`: "is_business_day" \| "add" \| "count"<br>`date`: object<br>`days?`: integer<br>`to?`: object<br>`weekend?`: "friday" \| "thursday_friday"<br>`holidays?`: array<br>`includeFixedSolarHolidays?`: boolean |
| `iran_holidays` | Fixed solar-calendar public holidays of a Jalali year (Nowruz 1-4 Farvardin, 12-13 Farvardin, 14-15 Khordad, 22 Bahman, 29 Esfand) with Gregorian dates, plus the Hijri-based holiday list WITHOUT dates. Lunar holidays shift yearly and need the official annual calendar. | `year`: integer |
| `parse_iran_address` | Heuristically extract province, city (province capitals only), valid postal code, and plaque/unit/floor numbers from a Persian address string. | `text`: string |
